headline: Fiat Launches Algerian-Produced SUV to Fill Market Void After Renault Exit
summary: Stellantis-owned Fiat introduced a limited-edition SUV assembled in Algeria, specifically tailored for local buyers following Renault's departure from the market.
why: Algeria represents North Africa's second-largest automotive market, encouraging local manufacturing initiatives under industrial localization policies.

impacts.name: Stellantis NV / Fiat
impacts.why: Fiat gains market share in Algeria by commercializing locally produced vehicle models.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
